correctness.rationale: For \(G=K_{n_1,\ldots,n_r}\), once the first vertex is chosen from a part \(P\), all vertices outside \(P\) are already dominated. Further vertices in \(P\) can footprint only themselves, while the first later vertex outside \(P\) dominates all remaining vertices of \(P\) and ends the sequence. This proves the complete structural dichotomy and all counting formulas. An exhaustive checker independently verified 85 small multipartite parameter tuples.
